supplementaryAnnotatedValueAudit.method: Secondary exact-field audit specified before this run probes. Remove only trailing citations naming refs actually read with valid provenance; preserve all strict verdicts.

limits: Source is delivered through native user prompts to avoid tool-result spilling. Large memory-tool results can also trigger the installed semantic selection backend; its calls and incomplete results are recorded separately.
pi-ai input excludes cached tokens; prompt is input + cacheRead + cacheWrite. Reasoning is included within output and also shown separately.
Native summaries omit the main request thinking field in the observed wire payload; the cache effect of this control difference is not causally established.
Failed transport calls without server usage are excluded from weighted token denominators; internal SDK HTTP retry counts and billing for those failures are unknown.
Checkpoint facts may support answers; verified memory_search and memory_read establish original-source recovery, not exclusive causal reliance on the memory plugin.
Three finite cycles in one new native session, not three independent runs or a provider-wide guarantee.
This is not a strict A/B comparison with cachefix.3.
A delivered original is not proof that every model explanation is semantically faithful.
